rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for deliberately harming or oppressing someone, especially because of their identity or beliefs.

example.english: They persecute us because of our different beliefs.
example.traditional: 佢哋因為信仰唔同而迫害我哋。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jan1 wai6 seon3 joeng5 m4 tung4 ji4 bik1 hoi6 ngo5 dei6

rows.note: Use this when the persecution is framed as bullying or repeated harassment of a person or vulnerable group.

example.english: They persecute the new student at school every day.
example.traditional: 佢哋日日喺學校欺凌新嚟嗰個同學。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jat6 jat6 hai2 hok6 haau6 hei1 ling4 san1 lai4 go2 go3 tung4 hok6

rows.note: Use this when an authority or powerful group is suppressing people, their rights, or their beliefs.

example.english: Those in power persecute people who dare to speak up for their rights.
example.traditional: 當權者一直打壓敢出聲爭取權利嘅人。
example.jyutping: dong1 kyun4 ze2 jat1 zik6 daa2 aat3 gam2 ceot1 seng1 zang1 ceoi2 kyun4 lei6 ge3 jan4
